response: Session-based recommendation can be modeled as a graph where items are nodes and edges capture transition relationships within a session, a perspective first operationalized by a graph neural network architecture that directly encodes these complex transitions [S2:0c7e1338a9c7914a3b9a5bdc42b457b3f272160e]. Temporal Augmented Graph Neural Networks extend this architecture by incorporating time‑aware edge weights to better reflect the recency of item interactions within a session [S2:dc3874003319001f276ec752dd427ac338619bf4]. A multi‑behavior variant further expands the graph representation to encode heterogeneous user actions, enabling the model to leverage auxiliary signals beyond clicks [S2:3a0b49179ce8f3ed5fe0d104f7c3817f7449770c].
